Situation: No connection when the user taps Register
User-visible state: Banner "You are offline - registration needs a connection"; button disabled
Server state: No request received; no user row
Expected result (testable): No request is sent; no user exists; form data stays on screen

Situation: Request committed but response lost; user taps again
Expected result (testable): Second request returns 409 EMAIL_TAKEN; exactly one user row; app offers login

Situation: No answer within 10 s
User-visible state: "Server not reachable - try again"; stays on login screen
Expected result (testable): No token stored; retry allowed; no server-side change

Situation: Opens search with no connection
User-visible state: Last results with label "Saved 09:41 - may be out of date"; Hold button disabled
Expected result (testable): Cached list shown with its generatedAt and position time; no hold possible offline

Situation: Answer arrives 6 s late and the user moved > 100 m since observedAt
User-visible state: Old list not shown; "You have moved - updating results..." then new list
Expected result (testable): Response echoes position + observedAt; app detects movement > 100 m, discards the result and reissues the query once with the new fix

Situation: Last GPS fix older than 2 min or accuracy > 100 m
User-visible state: "Getting your location..." (max 5 s), then results or warning "using last known position"
Expected result (testable): Request carries observedAt; response states distanceModel=STRAIGHT_LINE and the position used

Situation: Search times out
Expected result (testable): Reads are retried safely (max 2, back-off 1 s / 3 s); no operationId needed

Situation: Space list arrives after a 6 s delay
Expected result (testable): Each list carries generatedAt; hold is re-validated by server, so stale list cannot cause double booking

Situation: Connection drops before the user taps Hold
User-visible state: "You are offline - holding a space needs a connection"
Expected result (testable): Action BLOCKED (not queued); no pending operation created

Situation: Server committed HELD but response lost
User-visible state: "Checking your reservation..." then "Space A-01 held until 10:12"
Expected result (testable): App calls GET /operations/{id}; gets stored 201 body; exactly one reservation exists

Situation: Request never reached the server
Expected result (testable): 404 means not executed; app resends with SAME operationId; one reservation

Situation: User taps Hold twice / app retries
Expected result (testable): Second request with same operationId returns stored response with header Idempotent-Replay: true

Situation: Two drivers hold the same space for overlapping periods
Expected result (testable): Exactly one 201 and one 409 SPACE_UNAVAILABLE; no overlap in database

Situation: Same operationId sent with a different body (bug)
Expected result (testable): 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; request_hash differs; nothing written

Situation: Payment committed but response lost
Expected result (testable): GET /operations/{id} returns stored 200; exactly one successful payment (unique index)

Situation: Response delayed; hold expires during the wait
Server state: If paid before expiry: CONFIRMED; otherwise HELD->EXPIRED and no payment
Expected result (testable): Server decides using its clock: payment after holdExpiresAt returns 409 HOLD_EXPIRED and no payment row

Situation: Simulated decline then new attempt
Server state: DECLINED payment row then SUCCEEDED row
Expected result (testable): Each attempt has its own operationId; only one SUCCEEDED payment per reservation

Situation: Offline on payment screen
User-visible state: "You are offline - payment needs a connection"; hold timer still visible
Expected result (testable): Action BLOCKED; app shows server holdExpiresAt (not a local guess)

Situation: Cancel committed but response lost; app retries
Expected result (testable): Retry with same operationId returns stored 200; second cancel with NEW id returns 409 ALREADY_CANCELLED

Situation: Cancel arrives while hold expiry job runs
Expected result (testable): Exactly one terminal transition; loser gets 409 INVALID_STATE with current status

Situation: App reconnects after being offline
Expected result (testable): App reloads GET /reservations; server state overwrites cache; pending operations resolved first

Situation: History opened offline
Expected result (testable): Read-only view; statuses shown as last known with timestamp

Situation: Driver offline for 12 min after holding
Server state: HELD->EXPIRED by expiry job; space free
Expected result (testable): Expiry happens on server without client; GET /reservations shows EXPIRED

Situation: Two admins edit the same space
User-visible state: Second admin: "Changed by someone else - reload"
Expected result (testable): PATCH with stale version returns 409 VERSION_CONFLICT; first edit kept

Situation: Create-space response lost
Expected result (testable): Retry with same operationId returns stored 201; no duplicate label (unique per facility)

Situation: App restarted while an operation was pending
Expected result (testable): On start the app checks every pending operationId via GET /operations/{id} before allowing new actions
